ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Organization credential. Identifies the organization; does not identify an individual end user.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Client-supplied trace id, echoed back in `meta.correlation_id`. Never used as the request's own identity — that is always AIHUB-generated as `meta.request_id`.

UserAssertion.name: X-User-Assertion
UserAssertion.description: Signed organization assertion identifying the end user. Required for user-scoped operations.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Ignored. This operation never stores or replays an idempotency record.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. This operation may call a model, so a client that wants replay safety should send one.

Idempotent-Replay.description: Present with value true when the completed business result was replayed for this key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Trimmed and limited to 1–255 UTF-8 bytes. Scoped to (organization, operation, key); replays the stored result for a repeat call.

Idempotent-Replay.description: Present with value true when the completed business result was replayed for this key.
